input.command:
git add src/schedule.mjs && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fix urgentFirst to sort by largest priority first

The urgentFirst function was sorting entries in ascending order (smallest priority first) when it should sort in descending order. This caused urgent cargo lists to appear out of order. Reversed the sort comparator from `a.priority - b.priority` to `b.priority - a.priority` to put highest priority entries first.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
